webhooks.detail: No webhooks or event subscriptions in NotebookLM Enterprise API docs (v1alpha, Preview). Only notebook create/get/list/batchDelete/share and source methods.

evidence.quote: Pre-GA features are available "as is" and might have limited support.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox or test mode documented. Product needs Gemini Enterprise/NotebookLM Enterprise license and a Google Cloud project; docs only mention free-trial subscriptions.

evidence.quote: Users must be granted this role in order to access Gemini Notebook Enterprise (including for free-trial subscriptions).

rate_limits.summary: No API QPS documented; product usage limits only: 500 queries/user/day, 500 notebooks/user, 300 sources/notebook
